author: Nipovniki
quote: They left us with the most shallow story, characters and story ever. No difficulty (There are certain missions that you quite literally can't fail, either playing themselves or npc's just always miss their shots.), boring gameplay, horrible UI, game riddled with bugs, physics don't even work, certain 'protected' groups of people can't be killed (invincible, your bullets pass trough them, or if you try to run them over they destroy your car while not getting a scratch.)... not to even talk about how forced every line of dialogue feels in this game. I can go on forever. The bootlicking of big multi billion dollar companies is the reason the standards have gone so low
